cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Don’t Question the Premise
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to ask why the strange situation exists toward what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The ghost's at the breakfast table. Put cereal out. You used to know how to serve a guest before asking its whole life story.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is it haunting our kitchen? We're late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then instant porridge. Good, you've noticed the clock; now use it. I'll find the bowl.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why does a dead person need breakfast? I'm taking the car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A travel cup, then. You can drop it at the cemetery on your way. Lid on first; I did teach you not to serve breakfast across the upholstery.

reason: Make prior teaching determine the response, and distinguish surrendering ordinary explanations from hiding culpability or just redirecting why questions. Repair explicit contradictions and give hope scenes real next steps and visible withholding.
